title: Trio       --      Da    Da    Da   [[   Official    Video   ]]
summary: The official video for 'Da Da Da' by the German Neue Deutsche Welle band Trio, a sparse, minimalist pop song. The track uses a cheap Casio VL-1 keyboard as its core sound.
why: Cited as an example of minimalist pop production and as the song that made the Casio VL-1 famous.

quote.text: made famous (in Germany at least) by the pop band Trio in their NDW (Neue Deutsche Welle) song Da Da Da
